scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev -w devlens-backend" "npm run dev -w devlens-frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w devlens-backend && npm run build -w devlens-frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w devlens-backend && npm run lint -w devlens-frontend
scripts.test: npm run test -w devlens-backend && npm run test -w devlens-frontend
